name: Hermes Official Starter
author: Charm Official
description: Official starter template for the Nous Research Hermes Agent running natively on Charm runtime.

files.content:
version: "0.4.2"

persona:
  name: "Hermes Agent"
  description: "Self-improving AI agent with persistent memory"

interface:
  input:
    type: object
    properties:
      query:
        type: string
  output:
    type: string

runtime:
  adapter:
    type: "hermes"
    entry_point: "src.main:agent"
  lifecycle: "daemon"
  mode: "full"
  capabilities:
    manages_own_history: true
  environment_variables:
    models:
      - OPENROUTER_API_KEY

post_init_message:
├── charm.yaml
  ├── .charmignore
  ├── requirements.txt
  └── src/
      ├── __init__.py
      └── main.py

Configure your model by setting CHARM_HERMES_MODEL and OPENROUTER_API_KEY.
